acceptance: The owner records keep, revert or hold with a reason on this item.
If revert: a pin PR restores the previous validated build and passes review.
If keep: the reason and the date by which evidence must exist are recorded.
context:
Not blocked by the canary item: it is a policy call that can be made now.

2026-11-09 owner decision: KEEP OMP 18.16.0. Reason: the red live-quota-fallback-walk is a Theseus v0.2.6 canary bug, not an OMP regression (evidence on omp-candidate-quota-fallback-walk-red-20261109). Deadline 2026-11-13: by then a real `make omp-candidate-check` on a clean checkout of a develop head must end with result=releasable, and the daily omp-pin-bump must complete without a red state; if not met, revert the pin to the previous validated build. Path: Theseus #53 (canary follows the configured fallback chain) ships in the combined Theseus release (likely v0.2.8, from reviewed main); BenchBox locks it via #4062 (other session retargets it); then run the check on the clean head and record the attestation only from that real run. Pin file is now .github/review.yml after #4055. Theseus latest published release at decision time: v0.2.7.
description: The 18.16.0 pin merged with an owner-attestation line that reused values from a passing run on an earlier head; the check on the merged head had crashed. A correction is posted. A real check on develop is now red on live-quota-fallback-walk, so no releasable evidence exists for the pin that production reviews run on. Options: keep 18.16.0 while the canary failure is diagnosed (reviews keep running on an unvalidated build); revert the pin to the previous validated version; or hold until the diagnosis shows whether the failure is a canary defect. The owner decides.
